mapper.select: INSERT INTO platform.review_task (trace_id, tenant_id, run_id, source, priority, note) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{source}, #{priority}, #{note}) RETURNING task_id
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.review_task SET assigned_to = #{assignee}, status = 'IN_REVIEW', updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}::uuid AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW')

UPDATE platform.review_task SET status = 'RESOLVED', root_cause = #{rootCause}, note = #{note}, resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}::uuid AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW')
UPDATE platform.review_task SET status = 'DISMISSED', note = #{note}, resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}::uuid AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM platform.review_task WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') LIMIT 1
